messages:
lisa_sales: Acme security team asked for the completed SIG Q-file. We have ~36 hours. I made a question-by-question sheet: https://docs.internal.redwood/acme-sig-q1 (internal only). Need owners for three items: Q3.2 (encryption at rest), Q5.1 (RBAC + admin separation), Q9.4 (IR evidence). Who can take which?

ajay_seceng: I can grab Q3.2 and Q5.1. I'll attach KMS policy, rotation proof, and role mappings. Will also add a short narrative for the hosted vs dedicated model key handling.

tom_se: I'll prepare a short config excerpt showing KMS usage across Hosted/Dedicated/Private and where customer controls apply. Plan to upload: `redwood-kms-summary.pdf` and `dedicated-kms-example.conf`. Upload path: s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/

caroline_support: I'll own Q9.4. I have the IR playbook, last tabletop drill notes, and the post-mortem template. Where should I drop the drafts?

lisa_sales: Drop everything in Tom's S3 path and note status in the sheet (Draft / Ready / Needs Review). I'll be assembling the package for Acme.

sig-bot: Reminder: SIG deadline in ~36 hours. Outstanding items: Q3.2, Q5.1, Q9.4.

ajay_seceng: Uploaded initial artifacts to S3:
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/kms-rotation-policy.pdf
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/kms-rotation-events.csv
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/rbac-role-matrix.xlsx
I added notes to the sheet explaining scope and where customer-managed keys change control ownership.

tom_se: Sample snippet to include in Q3.2 answer (pasteable):
```json
{"encryption_at_rest": "Block device LUKS with AES-256; customer or Redwood CMK for cloud volumes; CMK rotation every 90 days; rotation logs attached."}
```
Use that + link to PDFs.

caroline_support: Uploaded IR artifacts:
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/ir-playbook.pdf
- s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/tabletop-feb2026-summary.pdf
Notes added in sheet: escalation matrix, notification SLAs, MTTD/MTTR from drills. @ajay_seceng please confirm the drill metrics.

ajay_seceng: Confirmed drill metrics: MTTD ~15 minutes, MTTR ~3 hours (drill figures). I'll annotate that these are drill results and link to metric dashboards. Also attached filtered kms-rotation-events.csv as requested.

jamie_compliance: Quick check: compliance may request a signed statement about rotation cadence and a SOC2 scope page. I can provide a 1-page SOC2 coverage summary and a short attestation template. Please flag readiness in the sheet so I can sign.

lisa_sales: Good catch. Tom/caroline/ajay please mark final artifacts ready by 10:30 PT tomorrow so I can route to Jamie for signoff.

tom_se: Will finish KMS config blurb and upload before EOD today.

caroline_support: I'll add a short incident timeline excerpt (redacted) to demonstrate cadence. Uploading now.

ajay_seceng: Done with final artifacts and short narrative for Q5.1 RBAC separation. All paths are in the sheet.

jamie_compliance: I reviewed docs. Minor edit: add a sentence clarifying that for Dedicated deployments, customer-managed keys place key custody with the customer. Otherwise looks fine. Marked draft as ready for signature.

lisa_sales: Thanks all. I'll bundle and post the compiled zip to s3://redwood-secure/sig/acme/evidence/2026-03-22/acme-sig-submission.zip and send to Acme sec team after Jamie signs. :thumbsup:

sig-bot: Submission assembled (pre-sign) and awaiting compliance signature. Deadline in ~28 hours.
